# IndusAGI Coding Agent

## What it is
IndusAGI Coding Agent is a terminal-first AI coding agent distributed as the `indusagi-coding-agent` npm package. Its installed command names are `indus` and `indusagi`.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/indusagi-coding-agent/latest

The documentation on this site is generated from the IndusAGI documentation corpus pinned at commit `a24f7e9823d0149e27bf05af912fba8dd959866c`.
Source: https://github.com/varunisrani/indusagi-docs/tree/a24f7e9823d0149e27bf05af912fba8dd959866c

## Install the TypeScript coding agent

```bash
npm install -g indusagi-coding-agent
```

The npm registry metadata requires Node.js 20 or newer.
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/indusagi-coding-agent
